description: The QNX 7.1 guest disk used by the CI job, pinned. The disk itself is QNX software under QNX's non-commercial terms: it is NOT in this repository and never will be (rule 'no binary in the repository'). This file is what makes it reproducible: the source is pinned by digest (docker verifies every layer against it during the pull) and the extracted disk is pinned by size and SHA256, both verified before the disk is used.

source.licence: QNX Neutrino, under the non-commercial terms of the QNX licence: not redistributable, fetched at run time and verified against the digest above
source.how_the_digest_was_obtained: registry-1.docker.io manifest lookup (GET /v2/autosarai/qemu_qnx7_1/manifests/1.1.0), the Docker-Content-Digest header, on 2026-11-12

disk.sha256_note: measured by the qnx71-guest CI job on 2026-11-12 (run 43238442733, artefact qnx71-guest-probe/disk.sha256) and pinned here: every run since then verifies it and refuses to boot a disk that differs.
